title: 'Hairy' Bigfoot spotted near Kennedy Space Center
excerpt: A hairy Bigfoot has been spotted in an open field of grass close to the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
content:
A "hairy" Bigfoot has been spotted in an "open field of grass" close to the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

Has Bigfoot been hanging out near the Kennedy Space Center?

Gail Kent was driving with her husband Bob around the area around eight miles north of the famous NASA facility on Merritt Island in summer 2023 when she saw a terrifying "upright black furred creature with long swinging arms" emerge in an open field close to some tall trees as they sat at a stop sign.

Reporting the incident to the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization, Gail explained: "I saw a Bigfoot in an open field of grass with tall trees toward our right ...

"This was to the south of us. We had stopped at a stop sign. I saw it as my husband was making a left turn."

She added of beast: "It looked slimmer than I would have expected a Bigfoot to be. It was slight, hairy and black. It walked on two feet. It traveled from left to right and disappeared within the trees ...

"My husband did not see it. He was negotiating a left turn onto the road in front of a grassy field."

BFRO Investigator Matthew Moneymaker looked into the sighting and wrote: "This Florida report is important because of the location - in the large (140,000 acres) wildlife refuge near the Kennedy Space Center ...

"I spoke with witness Gail Kent and her husband Bob by phone. They live in Cocoa FL but are originally from Ohio. They are both 77 years old and very credible.

"Gail and Bob are retired. They were taking a leisurely drive through Merrit Island National Wildlifre Refuge, and specifically Blackpoint Drive, some time in the Summer of 2023 (they are not sure of the exact date) ...

" Gail spotted the upright black furred creature with long swinging arms walking through the grasses toward a clump of trees. It was less than 100 yards away walking through waist high grass.

"She turned her head to observe it as the car made the turn onto the parkway. After Bob made the turn Gail began to yell: 'Stop! Stop! That's a Bigfoot! Turn around!'

"Bob turned the car around but by the time they were facing the area where the creature was last seen it has already walked into the trees and out of view."

Matthew added: "

There are many white-tailed deer and wild boar on the Merritt Island Refuge (140,000 acres). Black bears are officially listed as inhabiting the refuge also but sightings of them are exceedingly rare. Gail is adamant that what she saw was not a bear ...

"Gail said this Bigfoot was slim and not particularly tall. It was covered in black fur and slightly hunched forward as it walked quickly toward the trees.

"Interesting to note in this case: Any Bigfoots living in this part of Merritt Island would have surely seen and heard rocket launches from the NASA facilities and SpaceX facilities many times."
